items.name: ExprSimplifier
items.summary: This structure handles API for expression simplification

methods.name: coerce
methods.signature: fn coerce(&self, expr: Expr, schema: &DFSchema) -> Result<Expr>
methods.summary: Apply type coercion to an [`Expr`] so that it can be evaluated as a [`PhysicalExpr`](datafusion_physical_expr::PhysicalExpr).

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new `ExprSimplifier` with the given [`SimplifyContext`]. See [`simplify`](Self::simplify) for an example.

methods.name: simplify
methods.summary: Simplifies this [`Expr`] as much as possible, evaluating constants and applying algebraic simplifications.

methods.name: simplify_with_cycle_count
methods.signature: fn simplify_with_cycle_count(&self, expr: Expr) -> Result<(Expr, u32)>
methods.summary: Like [Self::simplify], simplifies this [`Expr`] as much as possible, evaluating constants and applying algebraic simplifications. Additionally returns a `u32` representing the number of simplification cycles performed, which can be useful…

methods.name: simplify_with_cycle_count_transformed
methods.summary: Like [Self::simplify], simplifies this [`Expr`] as much as possible, evaluating constants and applying algebraic simplifications. Additionally returns a `u32` representing the number of simplification cycles performed, which can be useful…

methods.name: with_guarantees
methods.signature: fn with_guarantees(self, guarantees: Vec<(Expr, NullableInterval)>) -> Self
methods.summary: Input guarantees about the values of columns.

methods.name: with_max_cycles
methods.summary: Specifies the maximum number of simplification cycles to run.
